text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion gloriously triumphs in the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup! Air Groove warmly 
congratulates her on the victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause and cheers echoed from 
the stands. Fine Motion's brilliant run 
was surely etched deeply into everyone's 
memories...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished an incredible race, Fine 
Motion shares a laugh with her Trainer 
about what to do tomorrow. Only a few 
months left until she returns home. 
There's still time...!
